200.description: Budget groups visible to the caller

400.description: Malformed query parameters, or an invalid cursor or page size

403.description: Caller lacks management read access

get.description: Owner-managed workload issuer, with identity-egress JWKS verification and first-match claim mappings. Enabled writes validate public signing keys. Issuer URLs are immutable; disable an issuer without needing a working endpoint. Subject and mapping/project bindings are stable. No bearer token or raw subject is returned or stored.

403.description: Caller lacks the keys permission or project manager write access

412.description: If-Match does not name the stored ETag

put.summary: Replace SCIM group role and project grants
put.description: Owner-managed mapping for a provisioned group. Requires Access, a quoted ETag and current installation authority. Group membership changes reconcile these grants, preserve direct project memberships, revoke affected managed-user sessions and protect the last usable owner. SCIM PUT preserves an omitted OLP extension; an explicit extension replaces it.

SCIMUser.description: SCIM-managed federated user. Attribute names are case-insensitive; ambiguous duplicates are refused. userName is a unique email. Roles/groups are computed read-only values. The OLP extension provides base grants; groups add grants. Password provisioning is unsupported. Local takeover prevents subsequent SCIM writes.

SCIMGroup.description: Flat group of SCIM users. Group role/scope grants combine with base user grants; project grants are inherited independently of direct membership.
